PICO Motion Tracker (hereinafter referred to as "the tracker") can be attached to objects for position tracking. In Object Tracking mode, if a paired tracker is within the visible range of the PICO VR headset, the system can track it in real time and output its 6DoF data for tracking either the tracker itself or any object it attaches to.
## Recommended content
It is recommended to read the "[Use DataProvider](/en_instructions-on-data-provider)" to learn how to use `DataProvider` to obtain tracking data, determine data availability, and determine the state of `DataProvider`.
## Limitations

* Object tracking data can only be retrieved when the app is in Full Space state.
* You can only use the Object Tracking interfaces to obtain data after switching the tracking mode of the PICO Motion Tracker to Object Tracking.
* Object Tracking mode and Body Tracking mode are mutually exclusive. When Object Tracking mode is enabled, Body Tracking data cannot be output.

1. Retrieve a `MotionTrackingProvider` instance.
   ```Kotlin
   @Composable
   fun MotionTrackingSample() {
       val motionTrackingProvider = remember { MotionTrackingProvider }
       // ...
   }
   ```

   `MotionTrackingProvider` instance is a singleton, and the entire process shares the same instance.

2. Call `start()` to start `MotionTrackingProvider`, add `TrackerRequestCompleteListener` to retrieve a list of IDs for available trackers, and remove the listener and call `stop()` when Object Tracking is no longer needed.
   ```Kotlin
   @Composable
   fun MotionTrackingSample() {
       // ...
       val trackerIds: MutableList<Long> = remember { mutableStateListOf() }
       DisposableEffect(motionTrackingProvider) {
           val requestCompleteListener =
               MotionTrackingProvider.TrackerRequestCompleteListener {
                   trackerIds.clear()
                   trackerIds.addAll(it.ids)
               }
           motionTrackingProvider.addRequestCompleteListener(requestCompleteListener)
           motionTrackingProvider.start()
           
           onDispose {
               motionTrackingProvider.removeRequestCompleteListener(requestCompleteListener)
               motionTrackingProvider.stop()
           }
       }
       // ...
   }
   ```

3. Use `dataFlow` to retrieve pose data for each tracker.
   You can choose different methods to retrieve data based on the specific scenario. For example, in a Composable function, you can use `dataFlow` to retrieve data; in ECS, you can use `latestData` to retrieve the latest data.

   ```Kotlin
   @Composable
   fun MotionTrackingSample() {
       // ...
       val motionTrackingData by
           motionTrackingProvider.dataFlow.collectAsState(MotionTrackingData(emptyList(), 0L))
       // ...
   }
   ```

5. Read the pose data for each tracker, convert the data's coordinate system, and set the result to `Entity`.
   ```Kotlin
   @Composable
   fun MotionTrackingSample() {
       // ...
       SpatialView(
           update = { _, _ ->
               val entities = rootEntity.getChildren()
               
               // Use the retrieved tracker ID to retrieve the data of the corresponding tracker
               trackerIds.forEachIndexed { index, id ->
                   motionTrackingData[id].let { pose ->
                       entities[index].apply {
                           components[TransformComponent::class.java]?.apply {
                               val position = rootEntity.convertPositionFrom(pose.position, null)
                               val rotation = rootEntity.convertRotationFrom(pose.rotation, null)
                               setPosition(position)
                               setQuaternion(rotation)
                           }
                       }
                   }
               }
           }
       ) { content, _ ->
           // Initialize your entity
       }
       // ...
   }
   ```


### Complete code sample
The following code demonstrates how to retrieve the real-time pose of multiple trackers and set it to the corresponding entity in the virtual scene.
```Kotlin
@Composable
fun MotionTrackingSample(){
    // Get a MotionTrackingProvider
    val motionTrackingProvider = remember { MotionTrackingProvider }

    // Obtain real-time tracking data from dataFlow
    val motionTrackingData by
        motionTrackingProvider.dataFlow.collectAsState(MotionTrackingData(emptyList(), 0L))
    
    // List of IDs for currently available trackers
    val trackerIds: MutableList<Long> = remember { mutableStateListOf() }

    // Use tracking data within the Composable's lifecycle
    DisposableEffect(motionTrackingProvider) {
        // Tracker request listener that returns the list of assigned tracker IDs when the request is completed
        val requestCompleteListener =
            MotionTrackingProvider.TrackerRequestCompleteListener {
                // Update the current tracker ID list
                trackerIds.clear()
                trackerIds.addAll(it.ids)
            }
        motionTrackingProvider.addRequestCompleteListener(requestCompleteListener)
        motionTrackingProvider.start()
        
        onDispose {
            motionTrackingProvider.removeRequestCompleteListener(requestCompleteListener)
            motionTrackingProvider.stop()
        }
    }

    // Create the root node in the scene
    val rootEntity: Entity = remember { Entity() }

    SpatialView(
        update = { _, _ ->
            val entities = rootEntity.getChildren()
            
            // Iterate over all available trackers
            trackerIds.forEachIndexed { index, id ->
                // Get the data for the corresponding tracker
                motionTrackingData[id].let { pose ->
                    entities[index].apply {
                        components[TransformComponent::class.java]?.apply {
                             // Convert the tracking data to the coordinate system of the root node and set it to the corresponding node
                            val position = rootEntity.convertPositionFrom(pose.position, null)
                            val rotation = rootEntity.convertRotationFrom(pose.rotation, null)
                            setPosition(position)
                            setQuaternion(rotation)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    ) { content, _ ->
        // Initialize your entity
    }
}
```

## Monitor the connection state of the tracker
You can monitor the connection state of the tracker to receive its real-time connection state changes.
```Kotlin
val connectionInfoListener =
    MotionTrackingProvider.TrackerConnectionInfoListener { 
        // Handle connection state changes
        Log.i("MotionTracker", "id: ${it.id} is now ${it.connectionState}")
    }
motionTrackingProvider.addConnectionInfoListener(connectionInfoListener)
```

## Monitor the battery level of the tracker
You can monitor the real-time battery level of the tracker, and remind users to charge it promptly or replace it when its battery is low.
```Kotlin
val batteryInfoListener =
    MotionTrackingProvider.TrackerBatteryInfoListener { 
        if (it.batteryLevel <= 0.1f && it.chargingState == UNCHARGED) {
            // Remind users to promptly charge trackers or replace them when their battery is low
            Log.i("MotionTracker", "id: ${it.id} battery low.")
        }
    }
motionTrackingProvider.addBatteryInfoListener(batteryInfoListener)
```

## Monitor the tracker’s key events
There is a button on the tracker. You can listen for the tracker's button events and receive a callback when the user presses the button, enabling you to implement corresponding interactions.
```Kotlin
val keyEventListener =
    MotionTrackingProvider.TrackerKeyEventListener { 
        // Handle button events
        Log.i("MotionTracker", "id: ${it.id} has been click.")
    }
motionTrackingProvider.addKeyEventListener(keyEventListener)
```

## API reference
The `MotionTrackingProvider` class provides Object Tracking-related interfaces. For more information, refer to the [API Reference](https://developer.picoxr.com/spatial-api/index.html).
